description: This file defines a Java class 'Job' which models a delivery or transportation job with various attributes such as IDs, status, parcel details, dates, and images. It includes constructors, getters, and setters for these properties.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A data model class representing a transportation or delivery job with attributes such as IDs, status, parcel details, and timestamps.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the job.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the job.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the job.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the job.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Returns the customer ID associated with the job.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID for the job.

methods.name: getVehicleId
methods.description: Returns the vehicle ID assigned to the job.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the date the job was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the job.

methods.name: getDateDue
methods.description: Returns the due date for the job.

methods.name: getPic1
methods.description: Returns the first picture URL or path.

methods.name: getPic2
methods.description: Returns the second picture URL or path.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns any comments associated with the job.
